raw_blocks: Solutions that Build, Feed, and Power the World
Our innovative solutions drive critical industries forward, ensuring sustainable growth and development globally.

Improving the quality of life for current and future generations by creating and delivering a variety of essential products across the industrial and agricultural end markets is nothing new for the people of LSB Industries, Inc. (LSB) . But it doesn’t end there. We are committed to playing a leadership role in the production of low and no carbon products that not only build and feed the world, but power it, as well.

Perpetually guided by our Core Values – Protect What Matters, Make it Better, Practice Integrity and Be One Team – LSB is building a culture of excellence through a focus on continuous improvement, sustainable and repeatable processes and clearly defined metrics defining our success.
Whether you’re a customer, a job seeker, an investor or are simply interested in our efforts to help decarbonize our world, we’re confident you will find what you are seeking at LSB .
At LSB, our vision is to be a leader in the production of low and no carbon products that build, feed and power the world.

We believe there is a substantial need for low carbon energy sources across various business sectors, and we are committed to helping meet that demand through the production and delivery of low and no carbon products to multiple end markets.

LSB supplies industrial and high purity metallurgical grade ammonia and nitric acid for many specialty applications. Our knowledge, expertise, and supply position in the nitrogen products we market, when combined with our logistical advantages, provide us with the capability to offer significant value to our customers.
Our fertilizer products – ammonia and derivative products – are used as nitrogen fertilizers that enable farmers to grow with efficacy, effectiveness, and efficiency.
Safety is part of our culture, and we work diligently to continuously improve and maintain a safe workplace for our employees and our communities.

raw_blocks: Formed in 1968 and headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, LSB manufactures ammonia and ammonia-related products at our facilities in El Dorado, Arkansas, Cherokee, Alabama, and Pryor, Oklahoma. We also operate a facility for Covestro LLC in Baytown, Texas. We are a vital supplier to the world’s leading chemical and industrial companies and to the U.S. agricultural market. The chemicals we manufacture are included in hundreds of products used by thousands of people every day.

LSB is committed to playing a leadership role in the production of low and no carbon products that build, feed and power the world. Our team is dedicated to building a culture of excellence in customer experiences as we deliver essential products across the industrial and agricultural end markets and, coming soon, the energy markets.
LSB is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker “LXU.”

Our Purpose, Vision and Values

raw_blocks: At LSB, we leverage multiple competitive advantages to provide our customers with the products they need, while ensuring they receive the best value for their investment. Our manufacturing facilities are strategically located in close proximity to key user end markets with multiple transportation options to ensure timely delivery to our customers. Our energetic Commercial and Sales teams are dedicated to meeting our customers’ needs with quality products, security of supply and superior customer service.
YOU MAY NOT SEE THEM, BUT YOU USE OUR PRODUCTS EVERY DAY

LSB supplies industrial and high purity metallurgical grade ammonia for many specialty applications, including water treatment, refrigeration, and power plants emission abatement. Nitric acid is also an important product in our industrial portfolio that is used to manufacture semi-conductors, nylon, and polyurethane intermediates. Our knowledge, expertise, and supply position in the nitrogen products we market, when combined with our logistical advantages, provide us with the capability to offer significant value to our customers.
MINING OPERATORS TRUST OUR PRODUCTS

Industrial grade, prilled low-density AN and AN solutions are needed by mining customers around the world as they extract coal, copper, gold, and other vital minerals. Transported in a non-explosive state to their destination mining, quarry, or construction site, our products are then altered to suit the specific use for which they are intended.
Chemical feedstock, emissions abatement, water treatments, refrigerants
Semiconductor, nylon and polyurethane intermediates, ammonium nitrate, metals processing, DoD contractors- armaments
Sulfuric Acid 93% Low Iron
Bromine, pulp and paper, water treatment, metals processing (lithium, vanadium, aluminum, etc.)
Food refrigeration, dry ice, enhanced oil recovery
Ammonium Nitrate Solution (ANS) 83%-86%
Ammonium Nitrate Solution (ANS) 50%
Explosives for mining, quarries, and other blasting activities
HELPING FARMERS TO GROW BETTER CROPS MORE EFFICIENTLY

Our agricultural products are used for growing a variety of crops and grains including corn, cotton, wheat, alfalfa, vegetables, and citrus – all across North America. Our fertilizer products – ammonia and derivative products – are used as nitrogen fertilizers that enable farmers to grow with efficacy, effectiveness, and efficiency.
Urea ammonium nitrate solutions (UAN)
Liquid fertilizer for corn and other crops
High nitrogen content fertilizer primarily used for corn
